recipe.title: Bolognese
recipe.notes: This is a BBC Food recipe.
recipe.prep: Set up both slow cookers (it is too big for one).

method.s: Heat the oil in a large pan and brown the mince in batches, then add to slow cookers.
Add the remaining ingredients to the slow cookers. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours, then uncover and turn to high for another hour until thick and saucy.
Serve with cooked spaghetti and grated parmesan, plus some seasonal veges.
